cards.body:
My work has focused on frontend engineering, React, TypeScript, design systems, and the collaboration between engineering and design.

Rather than inventing project case studies, I've kept my professional history together in one place: roles, responsibilities, technical skills, and education.

cards.heading: Making useful things.

Accessible interfaces, understandable code, maintainable systems, and the small details that make software easier to use.

Some of my code is available on [GitHub ↗](https://github.com/Ifletcher668).
